title: Velvety Briny Kenyan Cheese Skillet
description: A romantic Kenyan dish featuring Vasterbottensost cheese, tadka, and a blend of ovo-vegetarian-friendly ingredients, all cooked to perfection in a cast-iron skillet. This briny and shaggy skillet is sure to delight your taste buds.

ingredients.name: Vasterbottensost cheese
ingredients.notes: Swedish cheese with a nutty flavor

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a cast-iron skillet over medium heat.
Add the cumin seeds and coriander seeds and let them sizzle for a few seconds.
Add the diced onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the chopped spinach and cook until it is wilted.
Push the spinach mixture to one side of the skillet.
Crack in the eggs and scramble them until they are cooked through.
Mix the eggs with the spinach mixture.
Sprinkle the shredded Vasterbottensost cheese over the top of the egg mixture.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Cook until the cheese is melted and the skillet is hot and bubbly.
